# revParse

Resolve revisions and repository metadata.

## JavaScript

```ts
git.revParse({ abbrevRef?: boolean, showToplevel?: boolean, refs?: string[] })
```

## CLI

```bash
git --no-pager rev-parse [--abbrev-ref] [--show-toplevel] [<refs>...]
```

## Parameters

| Parameter | CLI | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `abbrevRef` | `--abbrev-ref` | `boolean` | No | - | Print the short symbolic name of a ref. |
| `showToplevel` | `--show-toplevel` | `boolean` | No | - | Print the root directory of the working tree. |
| `refs` | _positional_ | `string[]` | No | - | Revisions to resolve. |

## Output

Parsed as `custom`. `result.data` is `string`. Resolved value, trimmed.

## Examples

**Current branch name**

```ts
await git.revParse({
  abbrevRef: true,
  refs: ['HEAD'],
})
```

```bash
git --no-pager rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD
```
